model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представя разпределението на 6 категории в рамките на набор от данни, съдържащ 16 888 диалога. Има 6 сектори, представляващи категориите „user“, „conversational context“, „user-generated by six different LLMs“, „dataset includes 13 categories: comics, movies, writers, scientists, actors, artists, and customer sets, from a high number of sources“, „characters“ и „dialogues“. Секторът „user“ е оцветен в синьо, а останалите сектори са оцветени в зелено. Секторът „user“ заема приблизително 500 единици, докато останалите сектори за заемат приблизително 250 единици всеки. Диаграмата включва легенда, която идентифицира всеки сектор с неговия етикет.
model_annotations.English: Figure 3 presents a pie chart illustrating the distribution of primary categories and subcategories within the RoleplayPref dataset, which comprises 13 categories: characters, comics, movies, writers, scientists, actors, artists, and customer categories. The chart contains 13 slices, each representing a distinct category, with the largest slice, representing “Characters,” colored dark blue and appearing to occupy approximately 52% of the total area. The “Comics” category is depicted in a light blue color and represents roughly 18%, while “Movies” is shown in green and accounts for approximately 12%. The “Writers” category is colored orange and represents approximately 8%, “Scientists” is colored yellow and represents approximately 7%, “Artists” is colored red and represents approximately 6%, and “Customer Categories” is colored purple and represents approximately 5%.  All slices include percentage labels indicating their respective proportions, and a legend is present, providing a color-to-category mapping.  The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their area, visually emphasizing the relative size of each category.
model_annotations.German: Die Abbildung 3 zeigt eine Verteilung der drei Hauptkategorien in einem Datensatz von RollplayPref, der zur Bewertung von Sprachmodellen verwendet wird. Das Diagramm enthält 6 Segmente, die jeweils in einer anderen Farbe dargestellt sind: Gelb (ca. 36 %), Rot (ca. 28 %), Grün (ca. 24 %) und Blau (ca. 12 %). Es gibt Prozentangaben innerhalb jedes Segments, die die jeweiligen Anteile angeben. Das Diagramm enthält eine Legende, die die Farben den Kategorien zuordnet. Die Segmente sind nach absteigender Größe angeordnet, wobei das gelbe Segment das größte ist.
